title: Exorcist 98 Field Report round 2: triage of every high and critical finding
method: Fresh held-out set (fixtures/wild-scan-round2/targets.json), scanned once with the fixed rules. Every high and critical finding was read in context at the pinned commit (the flagged line and the lines around it; base64 was decoded and read). Where one file produced several findings of the same kind, the file was read once and the decision applied to each finding in it. The same three labels and the same standard as round 1 (fixtures/wild-scan/triage.json). Secret values are never recorded here.

labelsMean.true-positive: The finding points at something a security reviewer should act on: the threat the rule describes is really there.
labelsMean.debatable: The text really does what the rule describes (for example a working injection payload, or a remote script piped into a shell in an agent setup), but in context it is deliberate, openly labelled or low risk. Reasonable reviewers could disagree.
labelsMean.false-positive: The rule matched, but the threat it describes does not apply (placeholder, quoted example, data, formatting).
